parameters: \rIf I had a bike, it'd be easy to cycle to\nSlateport for some shopping.
\rI'd be able to buy Harbor Mail at the\nPOKéMON Mart in Slateport…
\rOh! You have Harbor Mail?\nWill you trade it for a Coin Case?
\rWell, would you give me that Harbor Mail anyways?
\rOh, I'm so happy!\nOkay, I'll trade you a Coin Case!
\rThat Coin Case can be used\nat the Game Corner.
\rA Coin Case is needed for the\nGame Corner.
\rThat Coin Case can be used\nat the Game Corner.
\bI hear people call me the Rock Smash\nGuy, but I find that sort of degrading.
\bI think I deserve a bit more respect,\nlike maybe the Rock Smash Dude.
\bI like that!\nHere, take this Hidden Machine!
\bIf you come across large boulders\nthat block your path…
\bWell, use that HM move and smash\nthem right out of your way!
\bYes, sir! Smash rocks aside, I say!\nWoohoo!
\bOh, yes, if you smash a rock, a POKéMON\ncould come flying out of hiding.
